title: Can LLMs Express Personality Across Cultures? Introducing CulturalPersonas for Evaluating Trait Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the Big Five (OCEAN) personality traits through culturally-specific scenarios across six countries. While it utilizes cultural norms and social values (such as Ubuntu in South Africa or punctuality in Japan) to ground these scenarios, the primary evaluation is centered on psychological trait expression and distributional alignment rather than religion, theology, or formal ethical/moral systems.
